cells.gaps: No source gives a station using the Crime Management System: the July 2026 fact (MWI-003) says it is still being introduced and counts none, which disagrees with the 2022 pilot of the combined crime record system in six districts (MWI-013), whose later use is not stated. How the record is made in the new system, a current plan and a funder are not stated; the only statements on rural stations come from the excluded essay, so no rural gap is flagged.
cells.note: A system for stations is being prepared: piloted in six districts in 2022 and, in July 2026, officers trained ahead of its introduction. Rung 3 needs it past its pilot and live in stations outside the capital, and no fact says so.
